verdict.rationale: Supabase's own docs refer to official client libraries for vector work and image transformations. Its llms.txt publishes per-language agent reference corpora for JS, Dart, Swift, Kotlin, Python and C#, which indicates official multi-language SDKs. Generated type-safe TypeScript definitions and a published Management API OpenAPI spec support SDK-based building. Missing for 10: a dedicated SDK reference or install doc in the pack, explicit naming of the SDK packages and their feature coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
